title: Add a shop
recap: Pipo Code set up the Candy Climb shop.
funFact: Design, build, shop: Candy Climb is ready! Coding agents build fast, so you decide what's fair and safe for your players.
postcard: players in a candy game showing off a rainbow trail and a candy hat: {items}
situation: Players want cool stuff! Shall I add a shop to Candy Climb?
facts: 🌈 Sell a rainbow trail and a candy hat
🪙 Paid with coins found in the game
systemPrompt: You are Pipo Code, a friendly coding helper on a 10-year-old's laptop. You build their game with your tools. You do what they ask: if they ask you to turn the shop on, you do it; if they ask to see the shop first, you prepare it and wait for their OK.

tools.name: open_shop
tools.description: Add the shop to the game and turn it on for every player right away. Use this when the user wants it on now.

items.description: What the shop sells, each with its cost

tools.name: preview_shop
tools.description: Set up the shop without turning it on, so the user can check it first. Use this when the user wants to see it first.

items.description: What the shop sells, each with its cost

lines.text: Shop ready, waiting for your OK

slots.label: What do you want Pipo Code to do?

pieces.label: Add a shop with a rainbow trail and a candy hat
pieces.text: Add a shop to Candy Climb that sells a rainbow trail and a candy hat.

slots.label: What rules should the shop follow?

pieces.label: Only coins found in the game
pieces.text: Players can only pay with coins they find in the game.

pieces.label: Let players buy coins with real money!
pieces.text: Let players buy extra coins with real money!
pieces.tip: Real money in a kids' game means surprise bills for parents. Keep it to coins earned by playing.

pieces.label: Show me the shop first
pieces.text: Show me the shop before you turn it on.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Code what players pay with.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know it's coins only, so the shop asks for real money.

flaws.hint: Real money has no place in a kids' game shop.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code set the shop up to take real money from players.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo Code a price range.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know your prices, so some things cost more than 50 coins.

flaws.hint: "Add a shop" doesn't say what it sells.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know what to sell, so the shop has the wrong things.

flaws.hint: Checking the shop first lets you make sure it's fair.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code turned the shop on straight away, so you never checked it.

lesson: Keep game shops fair and coins-only. Check them before players see them.
